title: Shader transitions
description: bookFlip, blurSlide, crossZoom, crosswarp, dissolve, dreamyZoom, filmBurn, linearBlur, ripple, swap, zoomBlur, zoomInOut from @remotion/transitions.
reasons: they draw the HTML into a canvas with the experimental HTML-in-canvas API, which the render browser does not have switched on; the DOM transitions (clock wipe, iris, flip, slide, wipe, push cut) are in the catalog
